_doc: Every Material Maker material Fleet Command ships (material-maker skill). Each is rendered from tools/materials/ptex/<name>.ptex (written by tools/materials/build_ptex.py) by tools/materials/export_materials.sh, and written by tools/materials/postprocess.py to assets/textures/materials/<name>/. size_px: the shipped map size (2048 at most); maps: the maps shipped; tile_m: the metres one tile covers; status: starter (proves the pipeline, not an approved look) or approved; use: what reads it.

materials.name: hull_plate
materials.use: painted hull plating, 0.5 m rows of plates with 6 mm seams

materials.name: emblem_platinum
materials.use: faction emblems: the Concord badge's polished platinum (frame, hub, bezels)

materials.name: emblem_enamel_signal
materials.use: faction emblems: the Concord badge's Signal blue enamel band

materials.name: emblem_enamel_night
materials.use: faction emblems: the Concord badge's night-sky field, with lit star flecks

materials.name: emblem_enamel_pearl
materials.use: faction emblems: the Concord badge's pearl enamel ship (the saucer, nacelles and tail)

materials.name: emblem_wood_laminate
materials.use: faction emblems: the Ssarith Hunt badge's bows (the Bow Rites), laminated wood

materials.name: emblem_enamel_forest
materials.use: faction emblems: the Ssarith Hunt badge's field, a dry forest (the hunting ground) in enamel

materials.name: emblem_fern
materials.use: faction emblems: the Ssarith Hunt badge's fern bed, modelled in its recess

materials.name: table_wood
materials.use: the faction screen's table: polished walnut boards, flat-sawn figure, pores, ray flecks (owner, 2026-11-06: "generate the best wooden textture you can with material maker")

materials.name: map_paper
materials.use: the campaign map's poster paper: aged cream, mottled, fibres, foxing; the page prints the map over it (owner, 2026-11-07: "a crusty print on old piece of paper with hexagon grid drawn on it")

materials.name: carpet_red
materials.use: the map room's floor: deep red cut pile (owner, 2026-11-07: "a room with red carpeting")

materials.name: wallpaper_floral
materials.use: the map room's walls: light red-orange roses on cream (owner, 2026-11-07: "light red-orange floral print")
